# Sure Footing

*Ennek teaches the Tolmach way of walking ledges to those who will follow him along the narrowest ledges of the South Path. Walk behind him, three ledges, and learn Sure Footing.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Midbarium](../towns/midbarium_quests.md) |
| Category | Side |
| Given by | [Ennek](../npcs/ennek_tolmach.md) |
| Level | 20 |
| After | [The Canyon Cairns](../quests/ennek_the_canyon_cairns.md) |

## Objectives

1. Look at the low ledge in [The South Path](../maps/south_path.md)
2. Look at the switchback ledge in [The South Path](../maps/south_path.md)
3. Look at the high ledge in [The South Path](../maps/south_path.md)

## Rewards

- 1,750 EXP
- 400 mesos
- Skill: [Sure Footing](../skills/tutors.md#sure-footing)
- +20 standing with Midbarium
- +30 standing with [Ennek](../npcs/ennek_tolmach.md)

??? quote "Dialogue"

    - Remember the trick for ledges I promised you? Here it is. The Tolmach have walked these canyons with goats on their shoulders since before the town had a wall. We do not fall, mostly.
    - It is not something I can tell you across a counter. You have to walk it. Feet, knees, eyes, and whistling, which helps more than you would think.
    - Walk behind me along the **three narrowest ledges of [The South Path](../maps/south_path.md)**: the low ledge, the switchback ledge and the high ledge, in that order. Stop at each one and look down when I tell you to.
    - I will be just ahead. Do not watch me, watch where my feet go. And if you hear me stop whistling, stop walking.
    - Fair enough. Ledges are not going anywhere. That is rather the point of them.
    - The low ledge, the switchback ledge, then the high ledge on [The South Path](../maps/south_path.md). Follow the whistling.
    - You looked down three times and you are still here. That is the whole lesson, really. Knees soft, weight forward, and never trust a stone you have not stood on.
    - Now it lives in your legs instead of mine.
    - That is **Sure Footing**. Open the skills window with **K** and you will find it there. The canyons will be a little kinder to you from now on.
